To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the power consumption of a typical modem depends on its operational mode and that a loaded link tends to decrease the power consumption of some modems, while increasing that of others.
the Linksys AG040 and Cisco 837 modems consume more power when they are loaded, and the power consumption of both Linksys modems is increased by a loaded NAT table.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the power consumption of household networking devices and how their power consumption is affected by their operational modes.
the power consumption of household networking devices and how it varies with the operational mode.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the power consumption of networking equipment depends on a number of factors including the equipment’s specifications and the traffic patterns.
the power consumption of networking equipment varies greatly, depending on the operational mode of the equipment and the traffic load.
the Cisco 837 ADSL modem consumes the most power when idle or loaded and the Linksys Wags 54G consumes the most power while receiving traffic.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the power consumption of networking equipment varies greatly depending on the operational modes of the equipment.
we have developed a methodology for measuring the power consumption of networking equipment, and have used this methodology to study the power consumption of three popular ADSL modems.

the power consumption of a modem can vary significantly depending on the operational state of the modem.
power consumption of networking equipment is highly sensitive to operational mode.
there is significant variation in the amount of power that a modem consumes when it is in different operational states.
